# Branch and PR Lifecycle Checklist: Branch & PR Workflow

**Purpose**: Review the requirements quality of the repository's issue-driven branch and pull request workflow before implementation planning and execution.
**Created**: 2026-09-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the /speckit-checklist command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the workflow requirements for creating a non-main feature branch before implementation explicitly specified and traceable to an active issue? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are the conditions under which branch creation is invalid or blocked explicitly documented, including closed or inactive issues? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK003 Are the repository rules for preventing direct work on main stated as requirement-level constraints rather than implied convention? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK004 Is the branch naming convention described clearly enough that the expected pattern is unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK005 Is the pull request target branch and review gate defined with explicit acceptance criteria rather than implied workflow steps? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK006 Is the meaning of “ready for review” sufficiently precise to support objective validation of implementation readiness? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK007 Do the branch, PR, and status requirements align across the spec, constitution, and project workflow without conflicting rules? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-004, §FR-007]
- [x] CHK008 Are the issue-traceability expectations consistent between branch creation and PR creation requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK009 Are project status transitions and ownership described consistently across all workflow documents? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK010 Are success criteria measurable for branch creation, review readiness, and issue traceability? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001, §SC-002, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK011 Are failure states for absent permissions, missing issue context, or invalid issue status defined as actionable requirements? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-006, §FR-008]
- [x] CHK012 Can the requirement that “work must remain traceable to the originating issue” be objectively verified in review? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002, §FR-005]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK013 Are primary, alternate, and exception flows documented for branch creation, implementation, and PR review? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, §User Story 2, §User Story 3]
- [x] CHK014 Are failure and recovery scenarios for permissions, network issues, or inactive issue states covered in requirements? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK015 Are requirements defined for the case where a feature branch cannot be created or a PR cannot be opened? [Coverage, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK016 Are requirements explicit for attempts to begin implementation on main or without a valid issue reference? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Are requirements defined for issue closure or reactivation scenarios that would invalidate the branch/PR workflow? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK018 Are requirements clear about what happens when a pull request creation step fails after implementation is otherwise complete? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK019 Are accessibility expectations for keyboard access, focus visibility, and semantic structure defined for any user-facing content affected by this workflow? [Non-Functional, Gap]
- [x] CHK020 Are responsive requirements for mobile, tablet, and desktop behavior specified for any user-facing feature touched by this workflow? [Non-Functional, Gap]
- [x] CHK021 Are content-integrity requirements defined so business claims and product information are not invented or misattributed? [Non-Functional, Gap]
- [x] CHK022 Are gallery or PDF access requirements represented where a feature includes document-based material or public content access? [Non-Functional, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK023 Are the repository dependencies on GitHub CLI, Git, and issue state assumptions documented and reviewed as part of the requirements? [Dependencies, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK024 Are assumptions about contributor permissions and repository access explicitly identified as prerequisites for workflow compliance? [Assumptions, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements clear about which non-main branch types are valid for feature, content, design, a11y, and infra work? [Dependencies, Spec §FR-001]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK026 Are ambiguous terms such as “ready for review” or “feature branch” mapped to objective criteria that can be checked without implementation details? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK027 Are there unresolved conflicts between the workflow requirements and the repository automation scripts that require clarification before implementation begins? [Conflict, Gap]
- [ ] CHK028 Are any out-of-scope exclusions explicitly stated for this workflow, especially where user-facing content or deployment concerns might otherwise be assumed? [Gap, Scope]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave checklist items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline when a requirement needs amendment before implementation proceeds.
